notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
Third Act! New bosses! New traits! Released game!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523140/32dabf6edef3d39b31cff62715dbf2c3d499e585.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] There 4 heroes with over 40 abilities and 225 upgrades, almost 100 passive and modifiers
[*] Four worlds with 27 enemies and 10 bosses, over a couple of dozens of interactive objects
[*] 6 quests for each pair of heroes, although there is no main quest ‘to save the world’, but we will continue supporting the game and may add new content in the future
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Patch for Jan 25
notes.notes:
Various balance changes. In general, the game is easier at the beginning.
Hardcore mode will be added soon to make up for it.

Tier 1 enemies have less HP (200->100)
Tier 2 enemies have less HP (200->150)
Stronger variants have additional 25 HP

Tier 2 and tier 3 enemies are nerfed
Added their stronger variants, which are identical to them before the changes in most cases

Fixed a case when targeting gets locked
Fixed the inability to choose an advantage with gamepads

As always we are waiting for your feedback

Have fun and great holidays!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Nov 16
notes.notes:
[b]Added Action Queue[/b]. When the previous action finished its execution but didn't finish its animation, a new action will be performed when possible.
Added 'Attack on Right Stick Release' option

Balance changes:
All Monk's abilties animation times reduced
Enemies animations are 10% slower, when a gamepad is used

notes.title: New Content Update for Nov 13
notes.notes:
NEW ABILITY

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523140/6036cd33c6bf813c58008ceb0bb6ae4166127a67.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523140/a0446f4505a358aa16f76994d3abae8b91158d80.png[/img]

NEW PASSIVE TRAITS
[list]
    [*]Paladin: Spiritual Strike gives 1 sec of invulnerability
    [*]Hunter: Spiritual Strike deals more damage
    [*]Wizard: Spiritual Strike recharges in 5 secs
    [*]Monk: Spiritual Strike interrupts actions of enemies with no armor
[/list]
NEW GAME MODIFIERS
[list]
[b]    Positive: [/b]
    [*]Gives 10 armor for every coin spent
    [*]Dash restores 50% of lost health over the last 1 second
    [*]Attack damage bonus for each ability off cooldown
    [*]Enemies take more damage from not their own element
    [*]Resurrect in the previous room with 100 health
[b]    Negative: [/b]
    [*]Wave spawns every 9 sec
    [*]Earn less gold
[/list]
CHANGES
[list]
    [*]Dialogues UI improved
    [*]Slom-mo when aiming now lasts upto 1 sec
    [*]Fixed UI flickering when new ability or enhancement acquired
[/list]
In the next content update there will be a new quest and new variations of enemies.

We are also working on action queues, detailed descriptions with stats and a casual game mode.
